questions: How do we preserve useful looseness while making a bag easy to return to?
Which connections would help you recognize a developing direction, rather than feel like another task list?

sources.reason: I read all five retained summaries and the selected home link; original absent wording is not inferred.

excerpts.naming: Wiggle Stash is the shared space; each collection is a Wiggle bag.
excerpts.selected-direction: Capture is separate from commitment and spans all life domains.

sources.reason: The maintained public definition records the selected names, raw/reading distinction and Jpsh! relationship.

uncertainty: The five existing notes are summaries. They cannot recover the exact wording of the original conversation.
The selected home link was inspected as a reference; its wider contents were not used as evidence.
readings.understanding:
I understand Wiggle Stash as a place where an idea can remain in motion before we know what to make of it. Its useful center is the material you choose to keep: a thought, a note, a recording or a link. My reading belongs beside that material, with its own date and sources. It should help us notice relationships and open directions without turning every intuition into a commitment.

The tension I see is between making an idea easy to revisit and fixing it too early into a project-shaped account. A Wiggle bag can hold that tension. The Jpsh! names a possible moment of activation; it does not have to be forced.

The selected home link was inspected as a reference; its wider contents were not used as evidence.
readings.understanding:
I now see continuity as the organizing purpose of Wiggle Stash. The selected material records what you chose to keep while an idea was forming. My dated readings add a situated account of the directions and relationships I was seeing. Preserving both, with their differences, can make the development of the idea legible later.

That gives a project a particular place: it can emerge from a bag and express part of its intuition, while the bag keeps the wider unfinished thread. A Nexus visit could help us explore a pinned version and produce something useful elsewhere. The roadmap reinforces that the original input remains with Wiggle Stash and that chosen privacy applies from the first capture.

bags.subtitle: Let useful discoveries travel between our tools.
bags.author: Nicolás Echániz & CompAII
bags.origin: Retained as an initial bag in the Wiggle Stash discussion on 12 October 2026.
bags.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
bags.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.
bags.next: Choose one useful capability and one receiving need, then compare the existing support before deciding what to adapt.
bags.occasion: When a useful capability appears in another harness, or a concrete need exposes a gap.
bags.boundary: This is one Wiggle bag, stewarded by AlterMundi/Skills. It does not own the general Wiggle Stash or an automatic observer.
